failures.claim: This section describes governance arrangements for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities, including climate-related risks and opportunities.
The entity identifies the governance body(ies) or individual(s) responsible for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities, including climate-related risks and opportunities.

The entity discloses how responsibilities for sustainability-related risks and opportunities (including climate-related) are reflected in governance documentation (terms of reference, mandates, role descriptions and related policies).

The entity discloses how the governance body(ies) or individual(s) determines whether appropriate skills and competencies are available or will be developed to oversee strategies responding to sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.
The entity discloses how and how often the governance body(ies) or individual(s) is informed about sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.

The entity discloses how the governance body(ies) or individual(s) takes sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities into account when overseeing strategy, major transactions, and risk management processes and related policies, including whether trade-offs were considered.

The entity discloses how the governance body(ies) or individual(s) oversees setting sustainability-related and climate-related targets, monitors progress, and whether/how performance metrics are included in remuneration policies.
The entity discloses management’s role in governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.
The entity discloses whether management’s role is delegated to a specific management-level position or committee and how oversight is exercised over that position or committee.

The entity discloses whether management uses controls and procedures to support oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities and, if so, how these are integrated with other internal functions.
